Name: Owljoy Where'd I Put It
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
[b][color=#f9cb9c][size=5]✿[/size][/color][color=#ea9999][size=5] WHERE'D I PUT IT? [/size][/color][color=#f9cb9c][size=5]✿[/size][/color][/b]
Ever put something in a chest and completely forget which one?
Where'd I Put It? is a simple storage finder that lets you search for an item and see exactly where you've stored it. Pick a result, press Track, and the mod will guide you to the right storage.

[b][color=#fce5cd]୨୧ FEATURES ୨୧[/color][/b]
✿ Search for items by name
✿ Finds items across your chests
✿ Searches chests inside sheds, barns, coops, and other farm buildings
✿ Supports Mini-Fridges
✿ Supports the main Farmhouse Refrigerator
✿ Shows how many of the item are stored in each location
✿ Combines multiple stacks of the same item in one storage
✿ Track a result to locate the exact chest or fridge
✿ Results are separated into pages when there are lots of matches
✿ Configurable menu key
✿ Translation / i18n support

[b][color=#fce5cd]୨୧ HOW TO USE ୨୧[/color][/b]
1. Open the search menu using your configured key.
2. Type the name of the item you're looking for.
3. Press Enter to search.
4. Find the storage you want in the results.
5. Press Track.
6. Head to the shown location and you'll see a marker above the chest that has the item.

[b][color=#fce5cd]୨୧ CONFIGURATION ୨୧[/color][/b]
The search menu key can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu.
There is no forced default key, so you can choose whichever key works best with your mod setup.

[b][color=#fce5cd]୨୧ REQUIREMENTS ୨୧[/color][/b]
✿ SMAPI
✿ Stardew Valley 1.6
Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended for easily choosing or changing your search menu key.

[b][color=#fce5cd]୨୧ INSTALLATION ୨୧[/color][/b]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Where'd I Put It?
3. Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Choose your search menu key and start searching.

[b][color=#fce5cd]୨୧ NOTES ୨୧[/color][/b]
Where'd I Put It? is meant to be a simple quality-of-life tool for those moments when you know you have an item somewhere... but have no idea which chest you put it in.

It doesn't move your items or give you remote access to storage. It just helps you find where you left them.
